principle: One important execution at a time. Reuse before creation.

blueprints.name: Repo Health Sweep
blueprints.goal: Inventory repository health and stale automation

blueprints.name: Failed Actions Triage
blueprints.goal: Rank failed workflows by reproducibility and impact

blueprints.name: Deployment Recovery
blueprints.goal: Repair broken deployment pipelines on bot branches

blueprints.name: Dependency Patch Queue
blueprints.goal: Group safe patch and minor updates

blueprints.name: Major Upgrade Isolation
blueprints.goal: Separate breaking upgrades from security fixes

blueprints.name: Duplicate PR Detector
blueprints.goal: Find overlapping PRs before new work

blueprints.name: Duplicate Repo Detector
blueprints.goal: Score repository overlap and consolidation candidates

blueprints.name: Failure Memory
blueprints.goal: Store failure signatures, fixes and recurrence

blueprints.name: Success Pattern Memory
blueprints.goal: Record durable fixes and increase future weight

blueprints.name: Prompt Quality Audit
blueprints.goal: Detect vague evidence and inflated confidence

blueprints.name: Prompt A-B Bench
blueprints.goal: Compare prompts on fixed benchmark tasks

blueprints.name: Council Fast Path
blueprints.goal: Skip unnecessary debate when consensus is strong

blueprints.name: Council Dissent Gate
blueprints.goal: Trigger only one meaningful challenge round

blueprints.name: Jury Blind Review
blueprints.goal: Score anonymized proposals to reduce bias

blueprints.name: One Task Lock
blueprints.goal: Prevent conflicting parallel execution

blueprints.name: Worker Assignment
blueprints.goal: Assign only relevant workers to one selected task

blueprints.name: Worker Result Contract
blueprints.goal: Require claim evidence risk test and result

blueprints.name: Security Veto Evidence
blueprints.goal: Require concrete FAIL or UNKNOWN for veto

blueprints.name: Healthcheck Registry
blueprints.goal: Map repositories to relevant runtime healthchecks

blueprints.name: Rollback Registry
blueprints.goal: Require rollback instructions for every implementation PR

blueprints.name: Bot Branch Guard
blueprints.goal: Block functional writes directly to main

blueprints.name: Secret Scan Guard
blueprints.goal: Detect likely credentials in changes

blueprints.name: Workflow Permission Audit
blueprints.goal: Detect overly broad Actions permissions

blueprints.name: Workflow Rerun Policy
blueprints.goal: Bound retries for reproducible transient failures

blueprints.name: Stuck Job Detector
blueprints.goal: Flag abnormally long or repeatedly cancelled jobs

blueprints.name: Website Link Audit
blueprints.goal: Detect missing pages href and src failures

blueprints.name: Custom Domain TLS Check
blueprints.goal: Verify apex and www HTTPS certificate and redirects

blueprints.name: GitHub Pages State Check
blueprints.goal: Compare Pages config CNAME and deployment

blueprints.name: Public Claim Verifier
blueprints.goal: Require proof for public website claims

blueprints.name: LAB Promotion Gate
blueprints.goal: Mark unfinished work honestly as LAB or beta

blueprints.name: Project Maturity Score
blueprints.goal: Score testing deployment activity and value

blueprints.name: Archive Candidate Review
blueprints.goal: Find duplicate low-value repos for manual review

blueprints.name: Open Source Reuse Scout
blueprints.goal: Search reusable solutions before creating code

blueprints.name: Innovation Candidate Score
blueprints.goal: Score value novelty feasibility demand and validation

blueprints.name: Smallest Prototype Builder
blueprints.goal: Build bounded prototypes before large systems

blueprints.name: Experiment Metric Gate
blueprints.goal: Require baseline target and actual result

blueprints.name: Actual vs Expected Learning
blueprints.goal: Compare predicted and measured impact

blueprints.name: Role Accuracy Weighting
blueprints.goal: Weight roles from historical recommendation accuracy

blueprints.name: TGPT Optional Worker
blueprints.goal: Use tgpt only when installed and available

blueprints.name: TGPT Code Review
blueprints.goal: Request bounded code review without auto-running generated shell

blueprints.name: Provider Circuit Breaker
blueprints.goal: Disable failing providers after bounded failures

blueprints.name: Zero Paid Spend Policy
blueprints.goal: Keep paid AI calls disabled without approval

blueprints.name: Provider Response Normalizer
blueprints.goal: Normalize provider output into evidence schema

blueprints.name: Local Model Adapter
blueprints.goal: Support local models without secrets in Git

blueprints.name: Council Job Queue
blueprints.goal: Persist NEW ACTIVE BLOCKED DONE task states

blueprints.name: Worker Heartbeat
blueprints.goal: Track last successful cycle and stale workers

blueprints.name: Daily Evolution Report
blueprints.goal: Generate evidence-based progress report

blueprints.name: Service Audit Product
blueprints.goal: Turn verified health reports into service blueprint

blueprints.name: Website AI City Status Page
blueprints.goal: Publish public-safe LAB status and architecture

blueprints.name: Self Improvement Review
blueprints.goal: Every ten cycles assess helpful harmful and duplicate automation
